Aim with your ears. Shoot when you hear the Zombie right in front of you.
Switching weapons is always faster than reloading.
When a Zombie gets too close, you'll hear your own heartbeat. That means it is within range of your Melee weapon.
You have only a few seconds to shoot Slot Machines and Diamond Zombies.
Use your Melee weapon if you run out of bullets and don't have time to reload.
Upgrade your favourite weapons in the Armory to make them more efficient.
Each shot you miss reduces your Combo Score. Try to be accurate to keep your combo up!
Diamonds are rare! Make sure you shoot them when you hear one, but don't take too much risk.
Upgrade Power Ups in the Armory to make their effects stronger.
Upgrade the Power Up drop frequency in the armory to get slot machines more often.
Kill Zombies to unlock new enemy types. Have you checked the Zombiepedia in the Journal section?
In Challenge Mode, Dr Bastard will pick a selection of weapons for you. However, you can select your loadout for Endless Mode in the Armory.
You have unlimited ammo in Endless Mode. In Challenge Mode, Dr Bastard will give you just enough bullets to defeat the Zombies he throws at you...
You can flip Tarot cards you don't like for just a few Diamonds.
Automatic weapons are powerful, but noisy! Stop firing and have a listen from time to time.
Beware of firing explosive weapons at Zombies that are too close. It will cause a deafening ringing in your ears for a few seconds.
The Snufflehog is the fastest Zombie in the game. Shoot it the moment you hear one coming!
The Farty explodes when it dies. Make sure you take it out when it's far enough away, or you'll be deafened for a few seconds.
If you run out of bullets when shooting at a Hulk, switch to your other gun, or wait until it comes close enough to finish it off with your Melee weapon.
The Zombie Dog sidesteps to either left or right when you shoot at it. Listen carefully to keep your aim true.
You don't want to shoot the Berserk. If you hear a Zombie sniffing around, avoid shooting it at all costs! It will go away in a few seconds.

Dr. Bastard can throw a jukebox, car alarms, a noisy generator or even cows in the arena to make it more difficult to hear the Zombies around you. You can always shoot these things to get a few moments of silence.
The better your accuracy over time, the better your reward when you die.
Consider Reviving if you got a favorable set of Tarot cards.
Having trouble locating Zombies? Turn around! It will greatly increase your perception.
if you think a Zombie is in front of you, but doesn't react to your shots, it may be right behind you.
The Chainsaw Zombie approaches you moving sideways. Keep track of his position or he'll cut you down!
